note.note:
I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript text (doctor–patient conversation)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON

Once I have these, I will produce the note with:
- Consult Summary (two-line)
- Problem List (Issue 1, Issue 2, Issue 3) including timeline, symptoms, ROS, social history, meds, exam findings, and DDx with likelihood and one-line justification when consistent with the transcript
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks (note any missing elements, conflicts, or transcript quality)

Notes:
- I will extract only information present in the transcript or DDx; I will not invent data (e.g., vitals, doses) beyond what is documented.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name with “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
